symptom: Owner reports Settings secondary controls and certificate dialogs appear to do nothing while the browser remains responsive.
confirmed_defect: The AppKit mouse path repeats native toplevel focus before button events. The common seat dismissed grabbed popup trees on every Focus, including activation of the same containing toplevel. A menu could disappear before its complete click reached Firefox.
repair: Treat repeated activation of the focused containing toplevel as idempotent. Preserve popup surface focus, modifier keys and implicit pointer grabs. Real toplevel changes and native focus loss retain dismissal and held-button release.
